data_source_note: Generated from synthetic test data produced by the WSA PCAP generator. Findings describe characteristics of artificial captures and do not reflect any real wireless environment.

findings.title: Open Network — No Encryption
findings.explanation: No RSN Information Element and no Privacy capability bit were observed in any beacon from this AP. All frames are transmitted in plaintext and client associations are unauthenticated.
findings.impact: Any passive observer on the same RF channel can capture all traffic including credentials, session tokens, and sensitive data without specialised hardware or an active attack.
findings.remediation: Enable WPA3-Personal (SAE) or at minimum WPA2-Personal (AES/CCMP). For shared-access networks consider OWE (Opportunistic Wireless Encryption, AKM 18) which provides per-session encryption without a shared passphrase.
